intro: A few quick questions so the coach can suggest where to start. Your answers stay on this phone.

questions.text: How old is the child you'd like to focus on?
questions.notes: If 'other': show a short message that the coach is designed for ages 4-16, then let the parent continue with the closest band or stop.

questions.text: What feels hardest right now? Pick up to two.

options.label: Getting my child to do what I ask
I get stressed or lose my temper
We have little good time together

questions.text: In a typical week, how often do you have a calm, enjoyable moment together?
How often do you end up shouting?
Is another adult raising the child with you?
questions.used_for: Module 4 co-parent step; pre-selects the other parent as practice partner.

questions.text: Realistically, how many minutes a day can you give this?
questions.used_for: If 'About 5', modules open in their short version.

questions.text: How would you like each week's module to start?

options.label: A short explanation of why it works first

questions.notes: Can be changed at any time in Settings or on the module screen. In 'practical' mode the explanation is one tap away.

questions.text: In your own words, what would you like to be different in a month?

ask_at_note: Fast start: only 'age_band' is asked at the start (experience.json > quick_start). The other questions are asked later, at the first check-in, when routing first needs them.
